summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for dizziness and shortness of breath, found to be due to hypotension and hyponatremia in the setting of peritoneal dialysis. She had a 10-pound weight loss and worsening nausea from longstanding gastroparesis. Peritoneal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cells, consistent with peritonitis, though cultures remained negative. She was treated with intraperitoneal ceftazidime, with clinical improvement. Hyponatremia resolved with fluid management, and bowel symptoms stabilized with a consistent regimen. She was discharged home with plans to continue antibiotics via her dialysis center, and follow-up with nephrology and GI.
